scope.unchanged: Ecological source tree population, species catalog, approved scenes. Dispatcher guards BIOME9; parent owns protected-biome regression.

capture.baseline: Generic existing wetland at matched study camera; original source retained at base commit
capture.lightingComparison: Before and after light changes are part of this authored biome profile; not a light-isolated test

rounds.hypothesis: A broad winding slough and batched sedges establish open wetland depth.
rounds.evidence: Large smooth river, bright pasted-sky reflection, isolated pale sticks and sparse banks.
rounds.cause: Confirmed continuous-channel height field and sparse thin-blade geometry; resemblance to canal instead of marsh.

rounds.hypothesis: Narrower channel, pool cuts and local foreground plant massing restore marsh dominance.
rounds.evidence: More coverage but stiff repeated V-spears; muddy empty raised bank ribbons and canal still dominate.
rounds.cause: Confirmed blade width/curvature representation and field-to-placement mismatch.

rounds.hypothesis: Thirteen curved blades per clump with base-to-tip pigment variation soften plant silhouette; smaller slough width and fragmented pools improve water/land balance.
rounds.evidence: Softer and lusher than R2, especially seeds41/613, yet exposed bank ribbons and simplified repetitive distant vegetation remain. Hero29 overemphasizes water.
rounds.cause: World-water-area fraction is only13.5%, but perspective gives channel much greater hero weight. Fixed terrain-field family produces similar layouts across seeds.

candidate.alpha: No alpha textures or transparency on sedge geometry; opaque depth-tested. Hardware overdraw unavailable.
candidate.timing: Eight CPU submission samples per view, headless software renderer, usually0.1-0.4ms. This is not GPU or mobile performance.

validation.objectiveLimits: No semantic vegetation coverage mask or hardware GPU counters. RGB darkness and field samples cannot determine aesthetic quality.

findings.defect: Continuous-channel geometry and exposed bank ribbons remain too mechanical
findings.next: Replace dominant channel field with patch/flow-derived shallow microtopographic mosaic and coordinated plant-mat coverage, not more uniform plants.

findings.defect: Sparse mid/far vegetation and repeated similar seed silhouettes
findings.next: Connected medium-frequency vegetation surfaces or inexpensive continuous mat representation with lower full-detail cost.

findings.defect: Water uses reflected sky lookup and repeated tiny ripple cue
findings.next: Restrained shallow-water scattering/wetness and lower-frequency roughness, actual reflection only if justified.

reusableRules.principle: Water/vegetation composition must be evaluated in projected camera space as well as world-area proportions
reusableRules.evidence: World water13.5-13.8%, yet hero29 still water-dominant

reusableRules.principle: Curved multi-blade clumps with darker bases and selective tip values outperform uniformly broad V-spears
reusableRules.limitations: Still visibly repeated low-poly clumps; no general approval.

stopReason: Three correction rounds used. Preserve source/evidence; human art direction required before more implementation.
